name: Boršice u Blatnice (Czechia)
description: Three vertical stripes of blue, yellow and blue in the ratio 1:1:1, with a red arrow-shaped charge with hooks in the yellow.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 31 January 2002 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
